articles.title: Mayoral candidate Dipika Damerla calls for independent auditor general in Mississauga
articles.summary: With just a few weeks until voters head to the polls in the Mississauga municipal election, mayoral candidate Dipika Damerla is calling for the city to have an independent auditor general. articles.title: Car flips after 2-vehicle crash in Vaughan, Ont.
articles.summary: Emergency crews responded to a two-vehicle crash in Vaughan, Ont. Monday night. York Regional Police say the crash happened just before 9:30 p.m. in the Keele Street and McNaughton Road intersection. One vehicle flipped on its roof. Police tell CityNews all injuries of those involved have been deemed non life-threatening. The exact cause of the […]

articles.title: Scarborough’s busway is open: What commuters need to know
articles.summary: The long-awaited Scarborough busway is set to open in just a few days. It will replace the route that the now-defunct Line 3 TTC line used to run. CBC’s Mercedes Gaztambide gives you an inside look at the new bus.

articles.title: Crews clean up 2nd spill at Scarborough creek linked to subway extension work
articles.summary: Crews from the city and the province have cleaned up a second spill in Scarborough's West Highland Creek linked to work on a subway extension in the area.

articles.summary: The Toronto Police Service (TPS) says a 16-year-old male pedestrian was among three people injured after a vehicle appeared to lose control in Scarborough on Monday afternoon. articles.title: Police identify 2nd victim in separate vehicle fires within hours of each other in Etobicoke, Scarborough
articles.summary: Toronto police have identified a body that was found in a burning vehicle in Etobicoke last week shortly after another body was found in a burning vehicle in Scarborough.

articles.title: 57-year-old man dead, 1 arrested after stabbing in North York: police
articles.summary: A 57-year-old man is dead after a stabbing in North York on Saturday night, Toronto police said.
